job.title: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
Position: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
Location: Surrey
Salary: £45,000 per annum + Overtime
Hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time
 
A prestigious FM service provider is seeking an experienced Electrical Maintenance Engineer to join their mobile engineering team, covering a localised portfolio of commercial sites across the Surrey and Merton areas. This is a fantastic opportunity to work within a professional environment offering excellent training, career progression, overtime opportunities, and a competitive pension scheme.
What you'll do:
  • Carry out planned and reactive electrical maintenance across a portfolio of commercial buildings.
  • Fault-find and repair electrical systems including lighting, power, emergency lighting, distribution boards, and associated building services.
  • Respond to breakdowns and maintenance requests, diagnosing faults and completing repairs efficiently.
  • Carry out routine inspections, testing, and minor electrical works to ensure systems remain safe and fully operational.
  • Support general building services maintenance and assist with remedial works where required.
  • Travel between localised sites across Surrey and Merton, ensuring maintenance requirements are completed within agreed timescales.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and ensure all works are completed in line with health & safety and compliance requirements.
What you'll bring:
  • City & Guilds / NVQ qualification in an Electrical discipline.
  • 18th Edition qualification.
  • Testing & Inspection qualification, ideally 2391 or equivalent.
  • Proven experience within commercial building services or facilities maintenance.
  • Strong electrical fault-finding and diagnostic skills.
  • A proactive, reliable, and professional approach to mobile maintenance.
Why Apply?
  • £45,000 per annum salary
  • Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
  • Van + fuel card provided with personal use permitted
  • Localised portfolio across Surrey and Merton
  • Overtime opportunities available
  • Excellent training and progression opportunities
  • Competitive pension scheme
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Electrical Maintenance Engineer looking for a localised mobile role across Surrey and Merton, with a strong package, training and progression opportunities, and the added benefit of a company van with personal use.

job.title: Electrical Shift Engineer (Canary Wharf)
job.description:
M&E Shift Technician - Canary Wharf
Location: Canary Wharf, London
Salary: Up to £57,000 per annum
Shift Pattern: Continental shift pattern
 
Are you an experienced M&E Maintenance Engineer looking for a new opportunity within a prestigious commercial environment?
We are currently recruiting for an M&E Shift Technician to join a well-established FM service provider, working within a state-of-the-art corporate office building in Canary Wharf.
 
This is an excellent opportunity for an electrically biased engineer who is looking to develop their technical skills and progress into a more senior position. The successful candidate will have the opportunity for fast-track career progression, with the role expected to develop into an Assistant Shift Lead position.
 
The Role
Working as part of a professional engineering team, you will be responsible for ensuring the building's M&E systems are maintained to a high standard, carrying out both planned and reactive maintenance across the site.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
  • Carrying out planned preventative and reactive maintenance across the building
  • Maintaining a range of electrical and mechanical building services
  • Responding to breakdowns and ensuring faults are resolved efficiently
  • Supporting the wider engineering team with day-to-day site operations
  • Ensuring maintenance is completed safely and in line with site procedures
  • Assisting with the smooth running of the shift and building services
  • Working towards progression into an Assistant Shift Lead position
 
About You
The ideal candidate will have:
 
  • Previous experience working within commercial FM or building services
  • A strong electrical bias would be preferred
  • Good understanding of both electrical and mechanical building services
  • Relevant electrical qualifications
  • A proactive approach to maintenance and fault finding
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills
  • Ambition to progress into a more senior engineering position
 
What's On Offer?
 
  • Up to £57,000 per annum
  • Continental shift pattern
  • State-of-the-art corporate office building in Canary Wharf
  • Fast-track progression towards Assistant Shift Lead
  • Excellent training and development opportunities
  • Healthcare after probation
  • Good pension scheme
  • Plenty of overtime opportunities
  • Opportunity to build a long-term career with a well-established FM provider
 
If you're an electrically biased M&E engineer looking for a role that offers strong earning potential, career progression and the opportunity to step into a leadership position, this could be an excellent opportunity.

job.title: Contract Manager

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Position: Maintenance Technician
Location: Bristol
Salary: £28,000 per annum
Hours: Monday - Friday, split day shifts between 6:00am - 7:00pm
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time
 
A prestigious FM service provider is seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to join their engineering team at a commercial static site in Bristol, with occasional cover required across four additional sites. This is a fantastic opportunity to work within a professional environment offering a stable role, good benefits, and a varied range of maintenance responsibilities.

What you'll do:
  • Carry out basic planned and reactive maintenance across a commercial building.
  • Complete minor repairs and general maintenance tasks including basic fabric repairs, fixtures, fittings, doors, and other building services requirements.
  • Respond to maintenance requests and ensure faults are dealt with efficiently to maintain smooth site operations.
  • Carry out routine inspections and identify any maintenance issues requiring further attention.
  • Oversee stock levels and materials, ensuring required parts and supplies are available to support service delivery.
  • Support maintenance requirements across four additional sites on an occasional basis.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure all works are completed safely and in line with site procedures.
What you'll bring:
  • Previous experience within a maintenance, facilities, or building services environment.
  • Good practical maintenance and repair skills.
  • Ability to carry out basic building fabric and general maintenance duties.
  • Good organisational skills, particularly around stock and materials management.
  • A proactive, reliable, and professional approach to maintenance.
Why Apply?
  • £28,000 per annum salary
  • Monday - Friday, split day shifts between 6:00am - 7:00pm
  • Commercial vehicle provided
  • Static Bristol site with occasional cover across four additional sites
  • 25 days annual leave
  • Competitive pension scheme
  • Stable, long-term opportunity within a professional FM environment
This is an excellent opportunity for a practical Maintenance Technician looking for a stable commercial role with a varied workload, company vehicle, and a competitive benefits package.
